messages.content: Return only one strict JSON object with exactly the key coefficient, whose value is a reduced rational string. No prose or Markdown.

In signature (-,+,+,+), take flat metric eta plus symmetric cubic H with H_02=H_20=-t*(x^2+y^2+z^2)/2 and every other H_ab=0, coordinates (t,x,y,z). From Christoffel/Ricci linearized about eta, compute the exact coefficient partial_x delta G_12 at the origin. Return {"coefficient":"..."}. This is one q2 basis coefficient only, not a full theorem.
